title: Repairs from final review of Task list
description:
Repairs routed from the epic's final review (tick 6vt). Apply exactly these; nothing else.
1. Move id and submitted-value parsing into src/lib/tasks/validate.ts: export `parseTaskId(raw: unknown): number | null` (accepts a string or number that is a positive safe integer; "0", "-1", "1.5", "abc", "", null → null; "12" → 12) and `submittedValues(formData: FormData): { title: string; notes: string }` (the strings as submitted, non-strings → ""). Add unit tests for both in src/lib/tasks/validate.test.ts (the listed cases). Replace the private copies `submitted()` / `taskId()` in src/app/actions.ts and src/app/tasks/[id]/edit/actions.ts and `parseId()` in src/app/tasks/[id]/edit/page.tsx with imports of these two functions. Behaviour unchanged (e2e must still pass post-merge).
2. e2e: keep the serial flow but make retries honest: in playwright.config.ts set `retries: 0` with a one-line comment explaining that the spec is one serial flow on a per-run database, so a retry cannot start from a fresh database. In docs/current/testing.md, state that e2e/tasks.spec.ts is one serial flow on a fresh per-run database and that tests build on each other's rows.
3. docs/current/how/tasks.md around line 123: rewrite the orphaned fragment into one sentence: "`getDb()` is imported only in the two `page.tsx` files and the two `actions.ts` files; client components receive plain data (`Task[]`) or the action function as props, so no `"use client"` file imports `@/lib/db`."
4. src/app/actions.ts: remove the unused `ok` field from AddTaskState and its assignment (nonce alone drives the reset); update how/tasks.md if it mentions `ok`.
5. src/app/components/add-task-form.test.tsx: add a test that types into the Title field, rerenders the view with a new nonce, and asserts the field is empty (proving the key-based reset).
Run: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm docs:check
